caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular box with a hinged lid, rendered in various shades of brown, beige, and tan to create a realistic texture that simulates wood or woven material. The surface of the box consists of horizontal and vertical lines, giving it a ribbed appearance. Both the lid and the sides are decorated with geometric patterns, including diamond shapes and zigzag lines in lighter shades contrasting against the darker background. The front of the box features two metal clasps in a silvery-grey color for securing the lid. A small handle is attached to the right side. The background is plain, with no additional objects or scenery, and the artist's initials “WBos” are inscribed in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Trunk
